2034-3652-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
2034-3652-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}
Repeat.

3525-4474-8299.description:
Activate Hemmer by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hemmer triggers, causing you to loot
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Hemmer.
Repeat.

4591-6731-8089.description:
Activate Deepwood Ghoul by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

4772-4871-6705.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Doubling Season.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1733-2724-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Nephalia Smuggler. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1765-1812-2440-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
1765-1812-2440-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

1978-3053-7170.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-7170.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Living Brain.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color(s)
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7158.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

444-2894-3885-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2894-3885-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Stinkweed Imp. Then, the draw will be replaced by Stinkweed Imp's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3809-4365-5147-7087.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2091-2493-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2493-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Archaeomancer with haste.
When the Archaeomancer tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-997-1269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-1269.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1594-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

104-589-5796.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-589-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
104-589-5796.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-3197-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-3197-4017.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-2438-5058.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

112-1170-2834-6586.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Displacer Kitten and Vivi trigger.
Resolve the Vivi trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Holding priority, activate Vivi by paying {0}, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Vivi.
When Vivi enters the battlefield, Hero's Blade triggers, attaching Hero's Blade to Vivi.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3534-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-3534-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1115-1308-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2440-3263-4183-4730.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-4183-4730.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sparring Mummy.
Repeat.

2981-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2981-5361-5365.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
2981-5361-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-783-943.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Jungle Basin.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Jungle Basin.
Repeat.
74-783-943.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Jungle Basin instead.

1365-1379-2292-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-2292-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

608-2022-2034-4094-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
608-2022-2034-4094-5495.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

5200-5457.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four creatures with different powers.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Selvala
5200-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Selvala
Repeat.
5200-5457.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1061-4118-5350.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing and/or control at least nine permanents.
Oriq Loremage does not have summoning sickness if Timestream Navigator is in your library.
1061-4118-5350.description:
If Timestream Navigator is in your library, activate Oriq Loremage by tapping it, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your graveyard.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Admiral Brass triggers, returning Timestream Navigator from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it, and giving it haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

508-1608-1656-4283.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
It is your upkeep.
508-1608-1656-4283.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Triplicate Titan.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Necrotic Ooze ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

1636-2034-3930-4343.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
You control at least four snow permanents.
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-3930-4343.description:
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

372-413-4681.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1634-1927-2567-3858.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
1634-1927-2567-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Devilish Valet.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Each Plant token enters the battlefield, triggering Devilish Valet that many times.
Resolve a Devilish Valet trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining Devilish Valet trigger.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

45-364-614-1987.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
